title: Newhalo everyday care
description: Everyday-use details on paper: a 64px heading on the left; on the right a dark graphite card with 8px corners (24px title, paragraph, a small tab-shaped icon fading into cobalt at its top right, and a product shot filling its lower part), then a plain text block underneath. The card blooms in; text rises 30px.
notes: the card stays dark on any theme (wraps itself in .dark)
